cases.description: Three independent, unrelated flags fire here: zeta is wildcard-pinned (high severity), request matches the known-risk-name table (medium), and eta has conflicting duplicate declarations (medium). All three are surfaced explicitly rather than collapsed into one generic 'multiple issues' note. suggested_risk_level escalates to REQUIRES_REVIEW specifically because of the single high-severity wildcard flag on zeta — the other two, on their own, would only reach NEEDS_REVIEW.
cases.grounding: risk_scorer.compute_risk_level returns REQUIRES_REVIEW because any(f.severity=='high') is true for the zeta wildcard flag; report.flags contains all three pattern_ids simultaneously.
